# blankcollar.ventures

> blankcollar.ventures is the ventures arm of The Blank Collar. We don't write the cheque — we make
> founders fundable for the AI era and connect them to the capital. Our "investment" is four things:
> the knowledge from theblankcollar.com, upskilling on blankcollar.university, AI operations
> (a configured agentic OS) on blankcollar.ai, and warm intros to the VCs we work with. We open the
> doors; the VCs we partner with write the cheques. Switzerland-based, global.

blankcollar.ventures is part of The Blank Collar — the post-AI worker practice. "Work is for bots. Life is for humans."
Coined in 2016 and founded in 2018 by Kristian Kabashi (Zürich, Switzerland). The Blank Collar is the
umbrella brand; its ventures are blankcollar.ai (the AI operating system), blankcollar.university (the
school), and blankcollar.ventures (the founder + ventures platform).

## Key facts
- Founder: Kristian Kabashi — https://www.kristiankabashi.com
- Brand: The Blank Collar — https://www.theblankcollar.com
- This venture: blankcollar.ventures — we make founders fundable (knowledge, AI operations, upskilling,
  and warm intros to the VCs we work with); we do not write cheques ourselves — https://www.blankcollar.ventures
- Formerly blankcollar.vc (now redirects to blankcollar.ventures).
